insufficiencies.why_it_matters: the claim says it sources repository_root from next_worker_context.repository_binding.repository_root, but the binding stores the root under 'path'; the claim therefore carries null
insufficiencies.should_have_been_protected: the claim should carry the binding's path value
insufficiencies.reference_could_supply: yes: repository_binding.path is present in the same packet
insufficiencies.receiver_impact: none: repository identity fully recovered from repository_binding; verification passes because both compared values are null

insufficiencies.issue: no authoritative reference to the prepared continuation artifact (next_worker_continuation.md)
insufficiencies.why_it_matters: the next bounded action dispatches the prepared continuation to the intended next worker; the packet references the transaction manifest, next-worker context, output validation, handoff packet, and review decision, but not the continuation prompt itself
insufficiencies.should_have_been_protected: arguably yes: a continuation reference would remove the receiver's dependence on same-directory convention or deterministic regeneration
insufficiencies.reference_could_supply: partially: the continuation is deterministically regenerable from two referenced artifacts (transaction_manifest + next_worker_context) using machinery at the bound commit, and it sits in the same directory as the referenced artifacts
insufficiencies.receiver_impact: low: the objective, scope, statuses, and selected next worker are all present, so the next bounded action is determinable; locating the exact continuation prompt requires one same-directory convention step or deterministic regeneration
